Method of Attack: Malware downloader that gathers system information and sends it to C&C server
Ability to download and run other binaries
Quits execution if user is not administrator
Attack Vector: Malicious code embedded in official CCleaner installer signed with valid digital certificate
Indicators of Compromise: Presence of Floxif malware in CCleaner 5.33.6162 and CCleaner Cloud 1.07.3191 binaries
